boardProfile.layout: Block Out Level 60 fills a 5×7 grid with a repeating pattern of green, blue, red, green, blue blocks, topped with orange. The dense packing means every column must empty from bottom to top — clear the green base first, then work the blue and red blocks upward, and finish with the orange top row.
landmarks: Block Out Level 60 fills a 5×7 grid with a repeating pattern of green, blue, red, green, blue blocks, topped with orange.
The dense packing means every column must empty from bottom to top — clear the green base first, then work the blue and red blocks upward, and finish with the orange top row.
The board mixes Green, Blue, Red and more.
The opening layout is a color-sort grid.
Clear matched tiles to finish the level.

quickTips: Clear colors from bottom to top within each column — do not skip ahead or blocks get trapped.
The green base must go first. Without it, the blue and red blocks above have no sliding room.
If the board feels stuck, look for the color with the cleanest path and use that to regain space.

steps.title: Move 1
steps.instruction: Clear the bottom green blocks toward the left exit to open the base.

steps.title: Move 2
steps.instruction: Shift the blue blocks in the lower rows out through the right exit.

steps.title: Move 3
steps.instruction: Clear the red blocks in the middle rows through the right exit.

steps.title: Move 4
steps.instruction: Move the green blocks in the upper-middle rows through the left exit.

steps.title: Move 5
steps.instruction: Begin clearing the blue blocks in the upper rows through the right exit.

steps.title: Move 6
steps.instruction: Finish with the orange blocks at the top through the top exit.

failurePoints: Clearing a blue block before the green below it, which traps the green with no sliding path.
Trying to clear the orange top row before the middle rows are open, which jams the board.
